svg.title: Original Dataset Audit and Trial Registry | Essex Biomechanical Loading
svg.desc: Essex source data audit and trial registry. The original source context and original workflow remain intact. A new middle row depicts schematic examples of 101-sample IMU signals, e1/e3 FE target profiles and source-field inspection. These curves are illustrative, not plotted research data. This audit records identity and provenance and does not fit strain models.

g.text: ORIGINAL DATASET AUDIT AND TRIAL REGISTRY
